_comment: Minimum tests that must EXECUTE per project. The control for defect class DC-012: a crashed test host reports success with a smaller count, and nothing else notices. Raise these with `python tools/verify-test-run.py --update` when you add tests; never lower one to make a run pass. Keys with a suffix are HALVES of a project run on one OS; `splits` says which halves must account for which whole, and verify-test-run checks that sum on every invocation, on both operating systems. AiDe.Core.Tests.nonportable is [Trait("Platform","Windows")] only - kernel32, powershell.exe, the net10.0-windows daemon, and tests that assert Windows path semantics on purpose. There is no quarantine category: every test that merely failed on Linux was diagnosed and fixed (INV-0005).
_baselineBump: 2026-09-10, node TH2 (spawn containment: the unchecked AssignProcessToJobObject at both shipped C# call sites, the job-handle lifetime in TerminalHostLauncher, the ACP engine tree that had no job object at all, and MSBuild node reuse in this gate itself). AiDe.Core.Tests 2205 -> 2206, non-portable 153 -> 154 -- one case, JobContainmentTests, Windows-locked because it calls kernel32 directly. Portable unchanged at 2052; AiDe.App.Tests unchanged at 495. MEASURED ON THIS TREE AFTER REBASING ONTO THE feature/composer MERGE, all four keys, each as its own run: 2206 whole, 2052 portable, 154 non-portable, 495 App -- so 2052 + 154 = 2206 holds by OBSERVATION, not by arithmetic on a number nobody ran. The first pass of this node measured against the PRE-merge main (2064/1912/152/456) and those numbers were discarded rather than carried forward. verify-test-run.py --update was NEVER run. Every floor raised; none lowered.
